rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose way to say that someone is becoming or feeling weary.

example.english: I start to tire after working late today.
example.traditional: 我今日返工返到晏，覺得攰。
example.jyutping: ngo5 gam1 jat6 faan1 gung1 faan1 dou3 aan3 gok3 dak1 gui6

rows.note: Use this when an activity or person makes A physically or mentally tired.

example.english: This report makes me tire out.
example.jyutping: ni1 fan6 bou3 gou3 gaau2 dou3 ngo5 hou2 gui6

rows.note: Use this for becoming fed up with or impatient with something, especially in more formal or written phrasing.

example.english: I am beginning to tire of this tedious job.
example.traditional: 我開始厭倦呢份沉悶嘅工作。
example.jyutping: ngo5 hoi1 ci2 jim3 gyun6 ni1 fan6 cam4 mun6 ge3 gung1 zok3

rows.note: Use this when someone or something makes A bored.

example.english: They talked for two hours and made me tire of the conversation.
example.traditional: 佢講咗兩個鐘頭，搞到我好悶。
example.jyutping: keoi5 gong2 zo2 loeng5 go3 zung1 tau4 gaau2 dou3 ngo5 hou2 mun6
